title: Chapter 227: Strange Creatures
content:
Chapter 227: Strange Creatures

I saw the old man suddenly appeared in front of me.

All the powerful Xie clan present were shocked. Although the old man in front of him did not deliberately release his breath, everyone still felt a terrifying feeling.

That is definitely not something that ordinary Immortal Emperor realm powerhouses can achieve.

Could it be?

However, the patriarch of the Xie clan was shocked. The next moment, under the shocked gaze of the tribes around, the patriarch of the Xie clan bowed respectfully to the old man in front of him.

"Mr. Ming, why did you come out?"

The patriarch of the Xie clan looked at the old man in front of him, with a hint of doubt in his respect.

If the powerful Xiao clan had not retreated just now, it would be no surprise that the old man came out.

But now the Xiao clan has retreated, and the person in front of him should not have come out.

The old man's name is Xie Ming. Obviously, he is a strong man of the same level as Xiao Fang of the Xiao clan.

This kind of existence will basically not appear when there is no major event in the clan on weekdays.

This is also the reason why Xie Changshou is confused.

At this time, Xie Lan's breath gradually stabilized, and Xie Lan's tense face gradually eased.

Xie Ming took a deep breath and then turned to look at Xie Changshou.

"From now on, let all the tribesmen be more low-key."

Hearing this, Xie Changshou was slightly stunned.

"What about Xiao clan?"

Hearing the word Xiao clan, Xie Ming's face changed, "The Xiao clan was originally a good friend to our clan, but it was not because of you!"

"My Xie tribe is already in a low point and can no longer stand the tossing."

"If you make such a wrong decision again, the position of the clan leader will be forgotten."

Xie Ming ignored the gazes of the tribesmen around him and accused Xie Changshou on his face.

However, Xie Changshou, the leader of the Xie clan, didn't even dare to give up.

Xie Ming is not the patriarch, but his words can determine his own destiny.

This is strength.

Xie Changshou nodded repeatedly and said yes, not daring to say anything more.

Seeing this, Xie Ming snorted coldly, then stopped talking about this topic, but turned to look at Xie Lan who was sitting on the ground, calming her mind.

"Your daughter is very talented. If you train it, your future achievements will not be lower than mine."

Looking at Xie Lan in front of him, Xie Ming spoke lightly.

But this plain words made Xie Changshou's heart explode.

Is your achievements no lower than yours? !

What a joke.

There has never been a single hand in existence like Xie Ming since the establishment of the Xie clan.

It is conceivable what kind of traitor qualifications are needed to reach the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Now, my daughter actually has this qualification.

"I, my Xie clan is about to rise?"

Xie Changshou's eyes were lost and he murmured to himself.

After a moment of silence, Xie Changshou suddenly knelt down to Xie Ming in front of him with a bang.

"Senior Ming, for the future of Xie clan, please take care of Alan."

Xie Changshou's eyes were filled with tears.

He had a lot of ideas. With Xie Lan's qualifications, he might not have attracted the attention of the other major forces in the Immortal Realm in a short time.

At that time, countless young people will inevitably appear to want to kill Xie Lan in the cradle.

Just like Xiao Yin of the Xiao clan was born back then.

Back then, I don’t know how many strong men hid in secret and wanted to kill Xiao Yin, who had not grown up, to cut off the Xiao clan’s retreat.

Unfortunately, they all failed in the end.

You should know that from ancient times to the present, there have been many monsters in the fairyland, but how many of them are truly able to grow up.

As an ancestor of the Xie clan, Xie Ming also knows this very well.

Xie Ming nodded and then said, "From now on, this girl's Taoist protector will be me."

At this point, the Xie tribe began to become very low-key, and the Xie tribe outside became fewer and fewer, almost fading out of the world's sight.

Only some forces understand that the Xie clan is raising his energy and waiting for the arrival of the real golden world of the Immortal Realm!

On the other side, within the Xiao clan.

Xiao Yin took Lu Xue and Xiao Luo back to the Xiao clan.

But at this moment, Lu Xue no longer had the desire to go on a walk.

"When will we go to that academy?"

Lu Xue held her face and looked at Xiao Yin with a eager look.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Yin smiled and said, "Miss Lu, you can do it anytime."

On the side, Xiao Luo was a little absent-minded.

Seeing this, Xiao Yin stumbling with his arm Xiao Luo.

"Ah, ah?"

Xiao Luo recovered and immediately understood.

"Miss Lu, we can set out now."

In this way, Xiao Yin had just returned to the Xiao clan without even sitting down, so he took Lu Xue and Xiao Luoma toward the direction of Tiandi Academy.

At this time, a figure that looked quite leisurely was wandering in the forbidden area in the fairyland.

It is regarded as nothing in the forbidden area.

"Tsk, there are no characters in this so-called fairyland."

Lu Daosheng felt the breath around him and shook his head slightly.

Lu Daosheng, who left the Xiao clan, did not return to the deserted city of the Wood Immortal Realm as soon as possible, but instead walked around the Immortal Realm to see if there were any strong people he had not noticed in the Immortal Realm.

But after a walk around, Lu Daosheng was obviously a little disappointed.

In his impression, the only strong man in the fairy world whom he likes is the old man who once had that fate at the boundary of nothingness.

That is the true peak of the immortal world. Now, I have not seen him.

Obviously, the other party has successfully broken through the limit of this world and left here.

After all, it doesn't make any sense for the other party to stay here.

In his eyes, all living beings in the fairy world may be like ants.

Just as Lu Daosheng sighed, an illusory figure suddenly appeared in front of Lu Daosheng, blocking Lu Daosheng's path.

"Huh? Is there something wrong?"

Looking at the phantom in front of him, Lu Daosheng raised his eyebrows slightly.

The next moment, the phantom gradually condensed and turned into a creature with only two wings on the back, with a human face and a beast body.

When he saw Lu Daosheng, his dark gaze became clear in an instant.

"Senior, can you please help me?"

The strange creature spoke respectfully.

This made Lu Daosheng unable to get rid of this.

I thought I was here to find fault, but I was ready to slap the other party to ashes.

"What's up?"

The strange creature fell on the ground, and then pointed to a direction away and said, "Senior, my body has been trapped there for a long time. I hope that Senior can save me."

"For you, it should be just a slight effort."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng immediately smiled.

"It's really a slight effort, but, why should I save you?"

As for the creature in front of him being trapped here, Lu Daosheng could guess the reason with just a guess. It would be strange if the evil spirit was not sealed.

When Lu Daosheng saw him for the first time, he saw the murderous intent deep in the other person's eyes.

If the other party hadn't given up his thoughts in time, he would have been dead now.

Lu Daosheng's words silenced the strange creature in front of him.

He is now penniless and doesn't even have freedom. What can he do to Lu Daosheng?

At this moment, strange creatures were in trouble.

Finally, I met an existence who could save myself and had no hostility or prejudice towards me, but I did not receive enough rewards.

At this time, the strange creature did not realize how much energy and wealth the man standing in front of him had.

Just that little thing, Lu Daosheng probably won't even take a look at it on the ground.

The only thing Lu Daosheng still had a little interest was the strange creature in front of him.

Seeing the creature in front of him not speaking, Lu Daosheng shrugged and then turned around and left in the other direction.

Seeing Lu Daosheng leaving, the strange creature suddenly became anxious.

"Let's wait!"

"Um?"

The strange creature trembled and appeared in front of Lu Daosheng again.

"Senior, I can do things for you."

At this moment, he finally realized his only remaining value.

However, when Lu Daosheng looked at him, he felt a little disgusted. Seeing this, the strange creature was slightly stunned. The next moment, a breath that did not belong to the Immortal Emperor Realm slowly overflowed.

In just a moment, the entire forbidden area began to tremble slightly at this moment.

At the same time, the law of mutation in the forbidden land began to collapse continuously.

"Senior, you are very strong, but I am not weak either."

The strange creature looked at Lu Daosheng and spoke with a hint of arrogance in his eyes.

Obviously, he is also arrogant, but he has been suppressed for too long and is eager for freedom.

But what he didn't expect was that Lu Daosheng still shook his head.

"I'm not saying that you are not strong enough. Although you are indeed weak, what I want to say is that you are too ugly and I feel a little bit vomiting when I look at it."

......

At this moment, the scene fell into a strange silence.

After a while, the strange creature clenched his fists and gritted his teeth and said, "What does this have to do with appearance?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said seriously: "Of course, I am not in much better mood when I see you. Why should I save you? Do you disgust me?"

After saying this, Lu Daosheng continued to leave.

In place, the strange creature looked at Lu Daosheng's back as he left, his eyes turned red, and his breath began to surge wildly.

But he did not take action. Until Lu Daosheng left the forbidden area, he did not choose to take action against Lu Daosheng.

He dared not.

The feeling that Lu Daosheng gave him was not powerful, but terrifying.

The moment he had thought for that moment, he felt a terror from the depths of his soul.

He had no doubt that as long as he dared to take action, he would die in the next moment.

Outside the forbidden area.

Lu Daosheng looked back and chuckled.

"I can really tolerate it."

At this moment, the terrifying aura in the forbidden area surged, and the void continued to shake. Obviously, some great terror was angry in the forbidden area.

However, in Lu Daosheng's eyes, these were just incompetent and furious.

But he can't blame him, after all, what he told the truth is.

That guy looks really ugly.

At this time, Lu Daosheng didn't know that because of his own reasons, one day outside, the strong people from the fairy world who came here suffered a great loss.

Finally, Lu Daosheng left and returned to the Wood Immortal Realm.

He was still very relieved about Lu Xue. After all, he only had such a daughter, so he naturally took good care of him.

With the backup moves she left on Lu Xue, no one in the entire fairy world could touch her.
